```yaml
name: Test Copilot GitHub Integration
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go mod download
          go install github.com/golang/mock/mockgen@latest
          
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          go test ./...
          
      - name: Build binary
        run: |
          go build -o gh-aw ./cmd/gh-aw
          
      - name: Test compile command with default behavior
        run: |
          ./gh-aw compile --help
          
      - name: Test compile command with --no-instructions flag
        run: |
          ./gh-aw compile --no-instructions --help
          
      - name: Validate instruction files are created by default
        run: |
          ./gh-aw compile
          ls -la .github/instructions/
          ls -la .github/prompts/
          test -f .github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md
          test -f .github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md
          
      - name: Validate --no-instructions flag skips file creation
        run: |
          rm -rf .github/instructions .github/prompts
          ./gh-aw compile --no-instructions
          test ! -d .github/instructions
          test ! -d .github/prompts
          
      - name: Validate --no-emit flag skips both lock and instruction files
        run: |
          rm -rf .github/instructions .github/prompts
          ./gh-aw compile --no-emit
          test ! -d .github/instructions
          test ! -d .github/prompts
          
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          go test -v ./integration/...
          
      - name: Run static analysis
        run: |
          go vet ./...
          golangci-lint run ./...
```
